_comment: Snapshot of the two real vcpkg header-bundle source artifacts, kept honest about gzip.
The historical_gzip_* fields preserve what an earlier local replay of the real
build/main.py license-prepare produced over the immutable exports captured from CI run
38889306396 at commit e9199ab4132c4218ab76d9fcdb57a95255c7cb99; that CI run's own
license-prepare stopped at the libspng declared-expression mismatch, so those gzip
archives were not emitted by the CI job itself but by running the unchanged producer
locally over those exact exports. gzip output is not byte-stable across runtimes, so the
shipped artifact is now the portable UNCOMPRESSED tar counterpart: the main sha256,
artifact_filename and source_artifact_url address the uncompressed payload of those
captured gzip bundles, which independently equals the decompressed payload of the actual
Linux CI run 38940077654. This is not a claim that the old CI run emitted the new tar.
The real producer preserves the raw vcpkg RESOURCE DOWNLOAD FILENAMES, which carry a
git-commit prefix, so the deterministic bundle members keep those full names. An earlier
manual audit bundled the same headers under shortened names, so the old artifact address
and member paths no longer matched production.
The header bytes are unchanged between the shortened and the real bundles: each old_members
sha256 equals the corresponding members sha256; only the member name and therefore the
deterministic tar hash differ. These are two external third-party header bundles, captured
so the regression is not self-referential to any first-party own-source hash.

provenance.producer: local replay of the real build/main.py license-prepare over the unchanged CI run 38889306396 exports; raw vcpkg resource download filenames preserved
provenance.portable_tar: the main sha256, artifact_filename and source_artifact_url address the uncompressed tar payload of the captured gzip bundles, independently equal to the decompressed payload of the actual Linux CI run 38940077654; the gzip bundles were produced by a local replay of the unchanged producer over CI run 38889306396's immutable exports, not by that CI job, whose license-prepare stopped at the libspng mismatch
